17.name: All About Steve
17.overview: Bathed in the heat of Moreno Valley, Kenny has difficulty with names, so he calls an audible. Meanwhile, Brandi can’t catch a break without some help from above. Dave gets stuck with the business end of an unsatisfying locker.

17.name: There's No River in Riverside!
17.overview: The heat is brutal in Riverside, but thankfully, Dusty & Lupe find a way to get soaked. Brandi manages to dig up some “grana”. Lisa goes camping in an unexpected way, while Dave has to settle for a whole lot of… not much.

17.name: Million Dollar Brandi
17.overview: In West Covina, Dusty uses magic to find his treasure. Lisa, determined to make her carpenter father proud, looks for something to refurbish and ends up channeling something else.

17.name: Not Mary's First Rodeo
17.overview: The buyers return to Moreno Valley, where an old friend surprises them. Dusty & Lupe do their best to hit it out of the park. Ivy finds a couple of “less scary” coffins. Brandi isn’t going to let anything ruin her bright and sunny attitude.

17.name: It's a Brew-tiful Day in Fullerton
17.overview: Lisa keeps getting her lockers taken from her; Dusty and Lupe find the locker of her dreams.

17.name: Diamonds and Tigers and Bids... Oh My!
17.overview: All the buyers are excited about the upscale potential of Rancho Palos Verdes, but it’s Dave who finds his loot there. Brandi racks up a decent profit while saving herself from having to shell out for shelving.

17.name: The Slings and Arrows of Outrageous Lockers
17.overview: The city of Hemet reminds Kenny of a certain English poet, but he ends up focusing on the Eastern arts. Ivy spreads holiday joy as he battles it out with a new buyer who isn’t all that intimidated.

17.name: Goody Two Hundred-Shoes
17.overview: Kenny gets ganged up on in Riverside by the field of buyers. Dave buys an old unit and takes a voyage back in time. Ivy scores a locker that inspires him to go clubbing. Emily puts her foot down with a statement buy on a massive locker.

17.name: The Count of Montebello
17.overview: Back in Montebello, Kenny is determined to stop swearing by carrying around a cuss counter. Dave goes in big on a high-end locker. Ivy doesn’t hit the bullseye when it counts. And Dusty & Lupe hope to hear the pristine sounds of success.

17.name: Like Dollars for Chocolate
17.overview: Everything is coming up “Brandi” in Banning, as she milks all she can out of her buy. Ivy knows good tools when he sees them. Lisa forms some sweet success out of an otherwise bland unit, while Kenny scores on a high-brow horseplay hoard.

17.name: Hauntington Beach
17.overview: Kenny books an appearance with his dark side; Brandi finds evidence of a possible payday.

17.name: A Song of Vinyl and Denim
17.overview: Dave is helped by a fan in sinking a winning locker; Emily puts faith on a smaller unit.

18.name: Tchotchkes, Not Poppycocksis
18.overview: In Orange, Dave zeroes in on a stack of Benjamins. Dusty & Lupe go really big and manage to stay out of the weeds. Mary gets herself all chakra’d in Fullerton.

18.name: The Puppet Master of Lancaster
18.overview: The Lord of Lancaster tries to levy tariffs on his visitors, but Dusty & Lupe manage to distract him long enough to cut out a profit. Dave is finally able to see the light. Kenny’s new friends fit him like a glove.

18.name: Baby Jesus, Take the Wheel
18.overview: Torrance gives props to Dusty & Lupe who are haunted by their locker. Kenny manages to kill several birds with one locker. Brandi gets all medieval with some strange music boxes, while Lisa re-joins the rest of the fleas to drop some new records.

18.name: Butch Cassidy and the Mayonnaise Kid
18.overview: Back in Montebello, good things come in small boxes, unless you’re Lisa. Ivy’s locker brims with sellable items. Emily thanks her lucky stars for a mountain of merch. Kenny and his punchy pal rave about their frenzied find.

18.name: The War of the Riaches
18.overview: In Fullerton, Dusty drags a busy Lupe to the auction, where she decides to show him that “packed” isn’t always “stacked.” Dave refuses to let KinderCare influence his choices, while Emily, intent on following the mystery, ends up short a wheel.

18.name: It's Not Easy Drinking Green
18.overview: Lisa hosts Kenny at her "Airbnb" and sends him to Riverside, trapping him with a healthy breakfast.

18.name: The Skeet Smell of Success!
18.overview: Lisa shatters her record for most liquid in a locker; Brandi pulls some profit out of an unit.

lastEpisodeToAir.overview: Lisa shatters her record for most liquid in a locker; Brandi pulls some profit out of an unit.

overview: When rent is not paid on a storage locker for three months in California, the contents can be sold by an auctioneer as a single lot of items in the form of a cash-only auction. The show follows professional buyers who purchase the contents based only on a five-minute inspection of what they can see from the door when it is open. The goal is to turn a profit on the merchandise.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview:
The fourth season of the reality television show, Storage Wars aired on A&E from April 16, 2013 to July 2, 2013. It consisted of thirty episodes, beginning with the episode "The Big Boys vs. The Heavyweights" and ending with the episode "Super Bros. Shuffle".

This season of Storage Wars had more frequent buyers than the other seasons. There were lots of new buyers on the show.

All of the episodes this season were filmed at various self-storage facilities throughout Southern California, including Mini-U Storage, Storage Outlet and Extra Storage.

title: Storage Wars
